subject.title: iOS node paired via local-discovery approval is permanently unusable (node-only device), surfaced as misleading "Credential save failed"

question: Should an iOS device obtain its required operator role through an explicit dual-role or role-upgrade approval, or may successful setup-code redemption extend the device’s approved roles automatically?
rationale: The repair changes how a stronger bootstrap credential interacts with the durable owner-approved role boundary, so automation should not choose whether role expansion is implicit or explicitly approved.

options.title: Explicit dual-role approval
options.body: Make iOS request node and bounded operator roles together, and create a visible operator upgrade request when an existing node-only record is encountered.

options.title: Bootstrap role extension
options.body: Allow successful setup-code redemption to add roles authorized by its bootstrap profile to the existing device without a second owner approval.

options.title: Diagnostics-only mitigation
options.body: Keep authorization unchanged but replace the persistence error with accurate role-mismatch recovery instructions and an in-app re-pair action.

recommendation.title: Explicit dual-role approval
recommendation.body: Make iOS request node and bounded operator roles together, and create a visible operator upgrade request when an existing node-only record is encountered.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from the device-pairing history for deciding the durable role-approval contract.
